responsibility: This header declares `lazy_diagnostic_path`, an abstract `diagnostic_path` implementation for GCC diagnostics that postpones path construction until the path is queried. It defines the forwarding overrides, the `generated_p` state query, and the pure virtual `make_inner_path` hook that subclasses implement to synthesize the real path on demand. Its role is the diagnostics-side interface for avoiding unnecessary path-building work when warnings are disabled or otherwise not emitted.
same_name_distinction: Declares the abstract `lazy_diagnostic_path` interface, including the forwarding overrides, `generated_p` query, and pure virtual `make_inner_path` factory. In this same-name pair, the .cc supplies the lazy-generation method bodies and selftests.
